look_here_first: Mexican redbud is the smaller, more xeric-looking redbud: leaves are relatively small, thick, glossy, and characteristically wavy-edged, on a compact multi-trunked tree or large shrub.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: small multi-trunked tree or large shrub

lookalikes.differences: Compared with Texas redbud, Mexican redbud usually has smaller, more strongly wavy-edged leaves and a more southwestern xeric distribution.
